description: Bank of England official daily statistics (IADB) for one series code (default XUDLUSS) over the last N days, from the Bank's CSV download. Values as published; no interpretation of the series. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

days.description: How many calendar days back to fetch, 1 to 365 (default 30)

series.description: Bank of England series code, e.g. XUDLUSS (default)

name: finance_bank_of_england_iadb
title: Finance Bank Of England Iadb
